one_sentence_story: In 2004 at UW–Madison, Antoine Lutz, Matthieu Ricard, and Richard Davidson recorded 8 Tibetan practitioners (10,000–50,000 hours) generating unprecedented 25–42 Hz EEG gamma oscillations and long-range frontoparietal synchrony during unconditional compassion — elevated even at resting baseline and during non-REM sleep.
so_what_for_you: Treat **attention and compassion like physical fitness, not fixed personality**: even 10–30 minutes a day of deliberate focus and loving-kindness practice begins strengthening prefrontal-insula regulation, turning repeated calm states into your brain's new resting baseline.
